scope.description: A leader in the captured module whose latest configuration contains non-voters and whose only reachable peer is a non-voter, observed before any lease expiry or election changes its state.
assumptions: the caller reads the future's error as the answer to whether the node is still the leader
the configuration used by quorumSize and the configuration whose replication states receive the future are the same latest configuration
excluded: the correctness of the leader state itself, which the check reads back
the lease-based step-down path, which is a separate mechanism
any requirement on callers or transports outside the module

properties.reason: Independent applicability, correlated prerequisites and fully observed result comparison

adaptations: No target file is modified; the harness adds one external test file to the captured package and uses only public APIs (NewRaft, BootstrapCluster, State, Barrier, VerifyLeader, CurrentTerm, Stats, Shutdown) plus the module's own InmemTransport Connect and Disconnect for routing.

The configuration is a real two-voter configuration with one non-voter, bootstrapped on all three servers, so the quorum the leader computes is the voter majority and the non-voter is a genuine member.
The leader's route to the other voter is removed with the transport's own Disconnect; the non-voter keeps working normally, so the leader still sends and receives heartbeats.
Election and lease timeouts are long enough that the leader has not stepped down when the verification is issued, so the judged operation is the verification itself.

plan_uncertainties: The prefix contains one leader and one unreachable voter; configurations with several non-voters, or with the unreachable peer being the non-voter instead, are not exercised.
The check reports the verification outcome and the configuration, not a downstream stale read, so the consumer that would be misled by the confirmation is not part of the observation.

An unfinished verification is not distinguished from a failure by the compared predicate, so a run in which the future never resolves would be recorded without a violation rather than as a violation or a distinct outcome.
The leader is judged before its lease expires, so nothing here says how long the false confirmation remains available to callers.
grounding_unresolved: whether counting a non-voter's acknowledgement is deliberate, which no source states
which consumers depend on the confirmation
whether the heartbeat acknowledgement of a non-voter was intended to count toward verification, which no source states
whether the repair filters the counted acknowledgements by suffrage or stops registering non-voter replication states for verification
whether a slower or lossier transport would change which acknowledgements arrive inside the verification
